about: Summary of every run, as the lab's dashboard showed it, read from the experiment bucket (raw logs, snapshots and full exam scores are archived separately). Scores in %; gain in points over E15's frozen model on the same practice tasks; probe = [{day: tasks practised, score: % of the 200 probe tasks}]; exam base = BFCL v4 multi-turn base; headline = BFCL's category groups.
